source: author-confirmed manufacturer and anechoic-chamber radiation-pattern result supplied as a raster image
digitization: manual color-curve tracing against the plotted angle and gain axes, followed by shape-preserving interpolation for display
frequency_note: The supplied directional raster carried a 6.89-GHz label; at the author's instruction both antenna cuts are presented on the common 6.775-GHz comparison axis used by the manuscript.
accuracy_note: The plotted samples are approximate raster-derived values; the original manufacturer or chamber export remains the authoritative record.
